before-completing-pandemonium.player: You seem to be in a good mood.

before-completing-pandemonium.npc: Aye! I be the last o' me crew! Not even our ship left now!

before-completing-pandemonium.player: That doesn't seem like a reason to be happy...

before-completing-pandemonium.npc: Well, it means I be the winner!

before-completing-pandemonium.player: I see. So what happened to your crew?

before-completing-pandemonium.npc: It be a series o' bad luck! First, Bill, the lookout, collided with an albatross in the crows nest 'n took a tumble overboard.
Finally, the Cap'n sank the Snake Eyes sailin' north out o' Catherby.

before-completing-pandemonium.player: Hmm... Well, congratulations on having survived all that. All the best.

Finally, the Cap'n sank the Snake Eyes sailin' north out o' Catherby.

before-sailing-level-40.player: Hmm... Well, congratulations on having survived all that. What do you plan to do now?

before-sailing-level-40.npc: Well, I guess I be lookin' fer a new opportunity.

before-sailing-level-40.player: Well, at some point I hope to hire a crew to sail with myself, but I'm not really ready for that yet.

before-sailing-level-40.npc: Well, ye' know where t' find me when ye' are.

options.text: How about you join my crew?

steps.text: If the player's Sailing level is under 85:

steps.player: How about you join my crew?

steps.npc: Hmm... Nay, me hearty. I be thinkin' ye'd be the end o' me lucky streak.

steps.text: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 85 Sailing.
If the player's Sailing level is at least 85:

steps.player: How about you join my crew?

steps.npc: Aye, I'm ready to take another roll o' the dice!

steps.text: You recruit Jolly Jim as a crew member. He heads off in search of your boat.

when-at-the-pandemonium.npc: There's been a worrying lack o' sinkin' lately, Cap'n. Worried it's affectin' the crew's morale.

when-at-the-pandemonium.player: That doesn't make much sense to me...

when-at-the-pandemonium.npc: How're we supposed to score some free grog at the bar when we got no stories to be tellin'!

when-at-the-pandemonium.player: Sorry... I'll try to do worse, I guess.

while-at-sea.npc: I be lovin' a bit o' a lucky dip!
